//: Mirrors the root tsconfig, with the paths rebased and `lib.dom` added.
The declarations lean on DOM types -- `HTMLCanvasElement`, `Blob`,
`CanvasDirection` -- which the root config gets from @types/node's
environment. TypeDoc resolves against this directory instead, so the DOM
library has to be named or every reference to one renders as a broken
link and `invalidLink` validation fills the log with them.
`skipLibCheck` stays off for the same reason it is off at the root: these
declarations are the product, and the generator reading them is one more
thing that will notice if they stop making sense.
